title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 108
description: Ten questions on Psalms 108: a steadfast heart that wakes the dawn, God's word over Shechem, Gilead, Judah, Moab and Edom, and trust in God's help.

questions.text: What does the psalmist say about his heart in the first verse?
questions.explanation: Psalms 108:1 says: my heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and make music with my soul.

questions.text: After calling on harp and lyre to wake up, what does the psalmist say he will wake up?
questions.explanation: Psalms 108:2 says: wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.

questions.text: Among whom will the psalmist give thanks to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Psalms 108:3 says: I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and sing praises to you among the peoples.

questions.text: How far does God's faithfulness reach?
questions.explanation: Psalms 108:4 says his loving kindness is great above the heavens, and his faithfulness reaches to the skies.

answers.text: To the bottom of the sea
To the tops of the mountains
To the gates of the city

questions.text: With what does the psalmist ask God to save, so that his beloved may be delivered?
questions.explanation: Psalms 108:6 says: that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

questions.text: Which valley does God say he will measure out?
questions.explanation: Psalms 108:7 says God has spoken from his sanctuary: he will divide Shechem and measure out the valley of Succoth.

questions.text: Which one does God call "my scepter"?
questions.explanation: Psalms 108:8 says Gilead and Manasseh are his, Ephraim is his helmet, and Judah is his scepter.

questions.text: Which one does God call "my wash pot"?
questions.explanation: Psalms 108:9 says Moab is his wash pot; he will toss his sandal on Edom and shout over Philistia.

questions.text: What does the psalmist call vain?
questions.explanation: Psalms 108:12 asks God for help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.

questions.text: Who, according to the last verse, will tread down our enemies?
questions.explanation: Psalms 108:13 says: through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.
